title: Water Bill Tracking Statement vs Meter Variance
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:bill bill_type="water"
| where statement_vs_meter_pct=*
| stats avg(statement_vs_meter_pct) as avg_variance_pct max(statement_vs_meter_pct) as worst_variance_pct by provider
| sort - worst_variance_pct
description: Compares billed amounts or billed usage with your captured meter data for water bill tracking.
value: Variance tracking is useful for catching bad reads, estimated bills, or a broken capture pipeline.
implementation: Write a precomputed `statement_vs_meter_pct` field during bill reconciliation or ingest processing.
visualization: Table of provider values by average and worst variance percent.
grandmaExplanation: It totals when the official statement for water bill tracking does not match the usage you expected.
